mission.title: OUR MISSION
mission.p1: We believe change begins when someone dares to try something new. That is why ASTROZ exists to bring together technology, ideas, and the courage to create meaningful change. To us, technology is not merely a tool to make things faster or more efficient. Technology is a way to create opportunities, solve problems, and empower more people to take part in shaping the future.
mission.quote: "Courage is not having the strength to keep going—it is continuing to move forward even when you have no strength left."

pillars.title: MOVEMENT PILLARS
pillars.desc: We build technology as a space to learn, experiment, collaborate, and create real solutions. For ASTROZ, technology doesn't just belong to the best, but is open to anyone brave enough to try and co-create.
